note: Differences of tools/parallel-run.mjs that are explained and accepted: the legacy file restores these case files wrongly (its scurve setter drops the bass and legacy families), see docs/DEVIATIONS.md DEV-SNAPSHOT-RESTORE. Each diff line is pinned exactly: a change on either side fails the run. BPMN B9b (docs/DEVIATIONS.md DEV-B9B-RESOURCES with DEV-B9B-SETUP-SPREAD, DEV-B9B-HUB-TIMING and DEV-B9B-COACHING): the programme cost profile moves the NPV and the payback of the workbooks on purpose (training and governance from resources, each setup line spent over its activity's duration); the savings, run cost, effective automation and glass ceiling stay the legacy ones. The 105 other case files (app/fixtures/cases) move the same way (SPEC_FIXES FX-73 / FX-74): every NPV move equals the sum, over the programme lines, of the legacy discounted spend (the euro input over months 1–6) less the B9b one, asserted on all 107 by app/tests/domain/programme/parallel-run-b9b.test.ts; the five large moves (econ-roi-low, econ-roi-mid, econ-no-setup, setup-large, vb-gantt-alt) are the typed training and governance amounts replaced by the resource cost, see DEV-B9B-RESOURCES. The two DEV-SNAPSHOT-RESTORE lines carry the B9b profile too (the new build's NPV and payback moved in B9b; the legacy side still reopens the golden spline).
